_comment: OPT-IN example. Not loaded by the plugin. To use, copy the hooks block into a project's .claude/settings.json and replace the ledger file name, the drsi path and the campaign name. It blocks edits to the attempt ledger unless a passing `drsi check` ran in the last 6 hours.

hooks.command: case "$(cat)" in *ATTEMPTS.jsonl*) /path/to/dream-rsi/bin/drsi gate -c my-campaign --max-age-hours 6 ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac
